On desktop every change applies at once and a polite live region says “12 results”. Each value shows its count, and values with no matches stay visible but disabled, so shoppers never pick their way into an empty grid. Long lists show six values and “Show 3 more”, and lists of 15 or more get a search field. Price is a two-thumb slider over a histogram plus two inputs with the currency symbol. The slider applies when you let go and the inputs on blur or Enter, so typing is never interrupted.
Product Filters & faceted search for React

Product Filters is the left side and the top of a collection page: a sidebar of facets, the applied filters as chips, a toolbar with the count, sort and grid size, and a Load more button with progress. On phones the same facets open in a bottom sheet. Facets are plain data, { id, label, type, values }, with list, swatch, range, boolean and rating types, so they map from Shopify, Algolia, Meilisearch or your own database.

filtersToSearchParams and filtersFromSearchParams read and write ?color=Oat&price=40-120&page=2 with router.replace, so links can be shared and Back works. Keeping the page in the URL lets the browser restore the scroll position after a product page, because pages 1 to 2 render again.
